title: The Space creation Wizard has a Your look step that picks the Mega Theme
detail: SYS-8 (first half) of the Mega Theme build plan. The Wizard gains a Your look step between Name and Ready: the seven Mega Themes as chips with their library pitch, a Pick later choice, and the theme a /themes page named (?theme=, LIVE-1530) as the starting pick. The final pick travels in the same `theme` field to createSpace, which applies it with applyMegaTheme once the Space exists. The step is added by withLookStep beside the manifest's steps, so the manifest-only step list pin is unchanged. Still to come from SYS-8: a General kit and a lead page at publish, and the headless end-to-end probe (waits on the General kit, SYS-16).

verify.evidence: vitest lib/spaces/create-wizard.test.ts passes the look step cases.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const bad=[];const w=r("app/(main)/spaces/new/create-space-wizard.tsx");if(!/step\.key === .look./.test(w))bad.push("wizard has no look step");if(!/chosenWizardTheme\(theme, arrivedTheme\)/.test(w))bad.push("final pick is not sent as theme");if(!/withLookStep/.test(w))bad.push("look step not added");if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}'
